title: Explosion at Kumamoto Aeon Shopping Center following earthquake leaves 5 dead and several injured
summary: A gas explosion at the shopping center that was serving as a shelter caused multiple casualties and structural damage, generating shock in the community.

title: United States resumes bombings against Iran and tension intensifies in the Middle East
summary: The US launched new airstrikes against Iran after a pause, while the Houthis attack a Saudi oil tanker and war rhetoric increases.

title: Kumamoto earthquake leaves between 17 and 28 dead according to the latest official reports
summary: Japanese authorities updated the fatality figures, with 28 deaths related to the earthquake and 17 confirmed in other counts.

title: A 4.6 magnitude aftershock shakes Yatsushiro and Hikawa and damages the Yatsushiro city hall
summary: A new 4.6 magnitude earthquake affected the area already hit by the earthquake, causing damage to the recently rebuilt municipal building and maintaining the seismic alert.

title: Collapse of Nippon Seishi paper factory in Yatsushiro after earthquake leaves at least 8 dead
summary: The collapse of the paper plant during the earthquake caused multiple casualties and structural damage, according to reports from authorities and local media.

title: Kumamoto earthquake disrupts roads and paralyzes the Shinkansen bullet train in Kyushu
summary: Traffic on Kyushu Island was severely affected by the earthquake, with closures on main routes and the suspension of high-speed train service.

title: Prime Minister Takichi proposes reducing consumption tax to 1% on basic foodstuffs
summary: The government plans a drastic reduction in the consumption tax on food, amid a debate on the economic impact and the search for political consensus.

title: Wall Street suffers a drop of more than 1,000 points due to geopolitical tensions and fears about artificial intelligence
summary: The Dow Jones recorded its biggest decline in months, dragged down by uncertainty in the Middle East and doubts about the future of the technology sector.

title: Kumamoto earthquake leaves more than 20,000 homes without electricity and affects mobile communications
summary: Power outages and disruptions to telephone networks complicated rescue efforts and daily life in the affected areas.

title: World leaders express solidarity with Japan and offer assistance after the Kumamoto earthquake
summary: Leaders from Italy, the United States, and other nations sent condolences, while Taiwan declared itself ready to provide support to the victims.

title: Japanese government and political parties establish emergency teams to face the Kumamoto earthquake
summary: The central administration and political forces coordinated the gathering of information and relief measures for those affected.

title: Japanese population falls below 120 million for the first time in 42 years
summary: The number of Japanese citizens decreased by 910,000 people, while the foreign population reached a historical record of 4.03 million.

title: Keiko Fujimori assumes the presidency of Peru with an emphasis on national reconciliation and security
summary: The new Peruvian president promised to prioritize the country's unity, citizen security, and international cooperation at the APEC forum.

title: The Koshien high school baseball tournament will be broadcast live on NHK ONE and the Kumamoto team travels despite the earthquake
summary: The emblematic Japanese baseball competition will offer complete digital coverage, while the team from Arisake school, affected by the earthquake, departs for the stadium.
